parallels.note: “ ‘ “You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to Yahweh daily. Morning by morning you…

translations.web: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: On the day you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a year-old lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD,
translations.kjv: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.
